annotations.title: Resolve a legal identifier to CELEX

description: Turn a EUR-Lex URL, an ELI URI, an ECLI (e.g. ECLI:EU:C:2020:559) or a bare CELEX into the canonical CELEX number plus EUR-Lex links. ECLIs resolve only for case law in the LexAPI corpus (404 otherwise). resolvedVia: celex, url, ecli-corpus, eli-corpus, eli-cellar (Publications Office register) or eli (derived from the ELI pattern, unverified). verified: false is normal for CELEX and URL inputs, which are not looked up. Cost: 1 credit.

identifier.description: CELEX, EUR-Lex URL, ELI URI or ECLI.
